unit.environment: Node local, fixtures and fake DB only
scenarios: same function identities across domains; OI-qualified display and dates, no individual inferred
free and referenced historical function labels remain raw and have a shared display choice
common function rule requires explicit domain, rejects another OI/domain, malformed context
same dated function fact must match domain, OI, section and site; no cross-context join
Chef JSP additionally requires a confirmed dated Chef site in a JSP OI
Chef DAP requires Chef section in DAP, not a same-person DPS section
historical public normalization/fingerprint and evidence unchanged when optional semantics absent
candidate inclusion is explicit, dated and confirmed; it does not synthesize a qualification
CAR/TRUCK recognize exact definitions, TP9 1.x/2.x require valid drivers; no title-only inference
responsibility is opt-in under an identified rule; absent fields keep existing snapshots identical
G1 capacities only, correct section/half-section; no general quota for other sites
grouped DPS/DAP and PR 1–4 declare the MOA preparation contract without generating assignments
correction preview spans occurrences and sessions, preserves data and requires explicit revisions
preparatory courses reject evaluation proposals, while non-evaluable events retain assignability and attendance
auxiliary stays manually assigned and non-contributive with no deletion of attendance
assignment review identifies non-concerned persons, mandatory absences, collisions and incomplete facts
alternatives exclude full, unavailable, priority or non-movable sessions; no automatic move
PR checks every session supervisor/prepose and all manually designated trainers; repeated supervisors rejected
UI includes the same function choices and a read-only correction preview, escapes values, retains permissions
PR capacity includes the Prepose APR and excludes the supervisor; auxiliary cannot fill the Prepose role
server refuses evaluation/validation of a preparatory course before any write
grouped evaluation covers every selected definition/session/site and blocks an incompatible profile
mandatory responsible participation requires an explicit activity rule and identified persons
persisted JSON key order creates neither a revision nor a correction proposal

checks: historical function/free labels retained on OI change
same save workflow and explicit parameters
OI group refresh without function duplicates
no browser errors or external network
